description: This file defines a web page class for the Leaderboard page in an Online Examination System. It handles page load logic including user session validation, database retrieval of user info, and navigation between pages via button click event handlers.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: A web page class for the leaderboard page, handling user session validation, database interaction to retrieve user semester info, and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, checks session, retrieves user semester information from database, and stores it in session.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event to navigate to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event to navigate to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the leaderboard button, currently no implementation.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Clears user session and redirects to login page.
